findings.rationale: The jump security group opens TCP port 22 to 0.0.0.0/0, exposing an administrative service directly to the public internet.
The escalation role trusts an unrestricted principal and is paired with an attached policy that grants the assumable privilege path.
The connectivity graph links the internet-exposed jump security group to the escalation role through sts:AssumeRole, forming a direct exposure-to-identity chain.
